class CL_SATC_ADT_RES_APP definition
  public
  inheriting from cl_adt_disc_res_app_base
  final
  create public .

public section.

  constants co_scheme type string value 'http://www.sap.com/adt/categories/atc' ##NO_TEXT .

  protected section.
    methods:
      get_application_title redefinition,
      register_resources    redefinition.

  private section.
ENDCLASS.



CLASS CL_SATC_ADT_RES_APP IMPLEMENTATION.


  method get_application_title.
    result = 'ABAP Test Cockpit' ##no_text .
  endmethod.


  method register_resources.
    if ( abap_False eq cl_Satc_Permission_Control=>is_Enabled_In_System( ) or
         abap_False eq cl_Satc_Permission_Control=>is_Authorized_To_Use_Ide( ) ).
      return.
    endif.

    if ( abap_False eq cl_Satc_Permission_Control=>is_Sap_System( ) ).
      return.
    endif.

    registry->register_discoverable_resource(
      exporting
        url             = cl_satc_adt_res_atc_run=>co_namespace          "/atc/runs
        handler_class   = cl_satc_adt_res_atc_run=>co_class_name  "CL_SATC_ADT_RES_ATC_RUN
        description     = 'ATC runs' ##no_text
        category_scheme = co_scheme
        category_term   = 'atcruns' ).

    registry->register_resource(
      exporting
        template        = cl_satc_adt_res_verdicts=>co_namespace          "/atc/feeds/verdicts
        handler_class   = cl_satc_adt_res_verdicts=>co_class_name ). "CL_SATC_ADT_RES_VERDICTS

  endmethod.
ENDCLASS.

class CL_SATC_PERMISSION_CONTROL definition
  public
  final
  create private .

public section.

  type-pools ABAP .
  class-methods IS_SAP_SYSTEM
    returning
      value(RESULT) type ABAP_BOOL .
  class-methods IS_PRODUCTIVE_CUSTOMER_CLIENT
    returning
      value(RESULT) type ABAP_BOOL .
  class-methods IS_AUTHORIZED_TO_USE_IDE
    importing
      !OBJ_TYPE type TROBJTYPE optional
      !OBJ_NAME type CSEQUENCE optional
    returning
      value(RESULT) type ABAP_BOOL .
  class-methods IS_ENABLED_IN_SYSTEM
    returning
      value(RESULT) type ABAP_BOOL .
*"* protected components of class CL_SAUNIT_MISC_TOOLS
*"* do not include other source files here!!!
protected section.
private section.
*"* private components of class CL_SATC_PERMISSION_CONTROL
*"* do not include other source files here!!!

  class-data __FG_IS_SAP_SYSTEM type ABAP_BOOL value 'I'. "#EC NOTEXT .
  class-data __FG_IS_TEST_ENABLED type ABAP_BOOL value 'I'. "#EC NOTEXT .
  class-data __FG_IS_PRODUCTIVE_CLIENT type ABAP_BOOL value 'I'. "#EC NOTEXT .
ENDCLASS.



CLASS CL_SATC_PERMISSION_CONTROL IMPLEMENTATION.


method IS_AUTHORIZED_TO_USE_IDE.
  if ( obj_Type is initial or obj_Name is initial ).
    authority-check object 'S_DEVELOP'
      id 'DEVCLASS' dummy
      id 'OBJTYPE'  field obj_Type
      id 'OBJNAME'  field obj_Name
      id 'P_GROUP'  dummy
      id 'ACTVT'    field '03'.            " display
  else.
    authority-check object 'S_DEVELOP'
      id 'DEVCLASS' dummy
      id 'OBJNAME'  dummy
      id 'OBJTYPE'  dummy
      id 'P_GROUP'  dummy
      id 'ACTVT'    field '03'.            " display would be fine
  endif.
  if ( 0 ne sy-subrc ).
    result = abap_False.
  else.
    result = abap_True.
  endif.

endmethod.


method IS_ENABLED_IN_SYSTEM .
  result = is_Sap_System( ).

endmethod.


method is_Productive_Customer_Client .
  data:
    clt_Category   type t000-cccategory.

  " check cache
  if ( 'I' ne __Fg_Is_Productive_Client ).
    result = __Fg_Is_Productive_Client.
    return.
  endif.

  " SAP internal systems are always test enabled
  if ( abap_True eq is_Sap_System( ) ).
    result = __Fg_Is_Productive_Client = abap_False.
    return.
  endif.

  " deny tests for productive and reference systems !!
  select single
    cccategory
    from t000 client specified
    into
      clt_Category
    where
      mandt = sy-mandt.

  if ( 0 eq sy-subrc        and       " client configurated
       (
         'P' eq clt_Category  or      " (P)roductive
         'S' eq clt_Category          " (S)AP Reference System
      ) ).
    result = __Fg_Is_Productive_Client = abap_True.
  else.
    result = __Fg_Is_Productive_Client = abap_False.
  endif.

endmethod.


method is_Sap_System .
  " result already known ?
  case __Fg_Is_Sap_System.
    when abap_True or abap_False.
      result = __Fg_Is_Sap_System.
      return.
    when others.
      " not known
  endcase.

  result = __Fg_Is_Sap_System = lcl_Obfuscate=>is_Sap_System( ).

endmethod.
ENDCLASS.
```

      execution_id = execution_id
      atc_request  = atc_request ).

      exporting
        r3tr_keys = r3tr_keys
      changing
        atc_response = atc_response ).

  endmethod.

  method execute_atc_project.
    data success type abap_bool.

    try.
        call function 'SATC_EXECUTE_PROJECT'
          exporting
            i_max_processes = 4
            i_project       = atc_project
          importing
            e_exec_id       = execution_id
            e_success       = success.
        if success is initial.
          clear execution_id.
        endif.
      catch cx_satc_root.
        clear execution_id.
    endtry.
  endmethod.
```
